senses.gloss: pr. n. (v. preced. wds.) Mount Simanay (Sign), a substitute for Mount Sinai, introduced for argument.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 89a:7">Sabb. 89ᵃ</cite> (against one explaining <he>הר ס̇ינ̇י</he> as <he>הר שנעשה ס̇ימן̇ טוב וכ׳</he> the mount which has become a good sign for Israel) <he>הר ס׳ מיבעי ליה</he> then it ought to have been named Har Simanay; v. <cite ref="N00701"><he>נִיסַּאי</he></cite>.
